reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Update image-automation-controller to v1.0.1 by @fluxcdbot in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5542", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Environments that run image-automation-controller receive version v1.0.1 when upgrading to Flux 2.7.0; the release notes state no breakage, removed behaviour or required operator action for this update.
consequence.remediation: No action required; after upgrading to Flux 2.7.0, confirm the image-automation-controller pods roll out successfully on v1.0.1 and image automation policies still reconcile as expected.

proposed.statement: Flux 2.7.0 updates the image-automation-controller component image to v1.0.1; environments referencing that image are updated to the new version on upgrade, and the release notes state no required action.
